settings.text: Collagen is the main component of connective tissue and is the most abundant protein in the human body.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · It makes up approximately 30% of the who
settings.text: It makes up approximately 30% of the whole body and 70% to 80% of the skin's protein content. As a result, you'd be hard-pressed to find a body part that doesn't contain collagen. It's in your skin, hair, bones, cartilage, digestive system, and more.
Close-up of abstract, wavy, semi-translucent helical structures resembling DNA strands, with a soft, light gray background and smooth surfaces giving a futuristic, scientific appearance.

settings.repere: Titre H3 · The helix structure of collagen
Paragraphe · If you zoom in on a single collagen prot
settings.text: If you zoom in on a single collagen protein, you’d see that it’s made up of 3 chains of amino acids tightly coiled around each other. This makes collagen very strong and flexible — so it can give strength and elasticity to the skin, plus support muscles, tendons, and bones.
